title: Promptless: Bounce Back
tagline: Every AI went dark. Your old computer didn't.

email.subject: HELP game at 9
email.body:
HELP game at 9. Our poster bot is dead and every photo of the game ball came out squashed flat. I need the Comets ball back in shape and I have 5 photos and no clue. My roommate said type grep Comets notes.txt then open whatever it says??

Dex

notes: TEAM NOTES - DO NOT DELETE (Jordan this means you)
practice moved to Tues?? or Weds. ask Priya
bus leaves 7:15. Coach says 7:15 means 7:00
snacks: orange slices, NOT the sour kind
jersey #12 still missing. lost & found?
ball 1 = the old practice ball from the shed
Hornets have the other court at 6
poster bot said 'done!' then died. great.
photos: Sam took 5 of the game ball, all bad
ball 2 = Sam's cousin's ball, has a sticker
remember: shin pads, water, ID
ref is the tall one from last year. be nice
Priya's mum is bringing the big cooler
warmup song vote: tied again
who has the pump??? (not me) - Leo
ball 4 = school ball, fine for drills
parents: please park on the far side
photo day re-do maybe next week
Comets game ball = ball 3. Coach says it has to be perfectly round.
chant ideas: still bad. keep trying
ball 5 = the one the dog got to
fundraiser cookies: 40 sold, 12 eaten by us
Jordan: stop drawing on the whiteboard
poster needs: team name, date, the ball, BIG
library printer works if you kick it
Leo found the pump. it was in Leo's bag
away kits are in the blue bag, not the red one
Coach's number is on the fridge sheet
after-game pizza: pineapple debate banned
if anyone reads this far, grep exists. - roommate

replies.right: IT'S ROUND. it bounces. WE bounce back. you are a wizard.
replies.wrong_file: Message bounced back: that's not the Comets ball.
replies.wrong_shape: Message bounced back: coach says that's an egg.
replies.no_attachment: Message bounced back: you forgot the photo??
